parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
In mammals, the blood glucose concentration must be maintained within narrow limits so that the body cells can function efficiently.

Name the mechanism by which the blood glucose concentration is maintained within narrow limits.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A biosensor is used to measure blood glucose concentration to check that it is within the normal range.

Describe how a glucose biosensor works.
